scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.test:e2e: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example atlas_test_server && playwright test --project=product
scripts.format: prettier --write scripts src tests *.ts *.json README.md docs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check scripts src tests *.ts *.json README.md docs && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check
scripts.check: npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:rust
scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:rust && npm run format:check && npm run build:web && npm run test:e2e
